paragraphs.text: Good morning Elders and Sisters. I've planned a little better today and so I've already gotten some better results.
I want you to turn in your Preach My Gospel sometime today to page 150.

You'll read this powerful quote from President Thomas S. Monson. Quote, When we deal in generalities, we will never succeed. When we deal in specifics, we will rarely have a failure. When performance is measured, performance improves. When performance is measured and reported back, the rate of improvement accelerates.
Now in times like we're living in right now, this mindset counseled by President Monson is even more useful to us.

We have little control over our external circumstances, but never forget we will always have control over our inner internal attitudes. Those attitudes have huge control over our behavior and like the poets have said, they can make a heaven out of hell or a hell out of heaven.

Being specific in our planning creates purpose to our lives. Being specific in our goals creates motivation in our lives. Being specific in our measurements brings successful outcomes in our lives and significant contributions to the lives of others. Being productive in our lives and making contribution to the lives of others is what really creates happiness in our lives.
As I said earlier, the power of the mindset described by President Monson is extremely important to us right now in our present circumstances.

You might say, but President, I can't go outside and do what a missionary is supposed to do. But I would suggest that maybe you just need to pray about it, ponder over it, and you will then be given inspiration that will guide you to even more important actions you could take to fulfill your purpose as a missionary even better than what we've done in the past.

Review 1 Nephi chapter 17 for a full insight into how the Lord helps us to grow by literally giving us challenges. And when we manage our attitude in the face of that challenge and ask for help, He gives us solutions which give us new knowledge and new skills and new capacities.
Let me read just a few of these verses from chapter 17, starting with verse 7.

7 And it came to pass that after I, Nephi, had been in the land of Bountiful for the space of many days, the voice of the Lord came unto me, saying: Arise, and get thee into the mountain. And it came to pass that I arose and went up into the mountain, and cried unto the Lord.
8 And it came to pass that the Lord spake unto me, saying: Thou shalt construct a ship, after the manner which I shall show thee, that I may carry thy people across these waters.
9 And I said: Lord, whither shall I go that I may find ore to molten, that I may make tools to construct the ship after the manner which thou hast shown unto me?

10 And it came to pass that the Lord told me whither I should go to find ore, that I might make tools. So now Nephi is on the right track, but when he presents his plan to his brothers, he meets with some rejection. Let me read a few of those verses, starting with 17.

17 And when my brethren saw that I was about to build a ship, they began to murmur against me, saying: Our brother is a fool, for he thinketh that he can build a ship; yea, and he also thinketh that he can cross these great waters.

18 And thus my brethren did complain against me, and were desirous that they might not labor, for they did not believe that I could build a ship; neither would they believe that I was instructed of the Lord.

19 And now it came to pass that I, Nephi, was exceedingly sorrowful because of the hardness of their hearts; and now when they saw that I began to be sorrowful they were glad in their hearts, insomuch that they did rejoice over me, saying: We knew that ye could not construct a ship, for we knew that ye were lacking in judgment; wherefore, thou canst not accomplish so great a work.

That would be kind of tough to go through that kind of rejection and that kind of criticism. But Nephi was strong, and he didn't step back from his goal or his purpose, and he showed the Lord that he was going to be faithful to the revelation that he received. He was going to follow the counsel that he got. Let me read a few of those verses.

49 And it came to pass that I, Nephi, said unto them that they should murmur no more against their father; neither should they withhold their labor from me, for God had commanded me that I should build a ship.

50 And I said unto them: If God had commanded me to do all things I could do them. If he should command me that I should say unto this water, be thou earth, it should be earth; and if I should say it, it would be done.
51 And now, if the Lord has such great power, and has wrought so many miracles among the children of men, how is it that he cannot instruct me, that I should build a ship?
Well, Nephi is a great example to us about how to deal with challenges and how to get information from the Lord and act on it to build our own capacities.

My brothers and sisters, my elders and sisters, we need to liken the scriptures unto ourselves. In our present circumstances, we are faced with a big challenge, just like Nephi was faced with a great ocean. He needed a ship, but he didn't know how to build one.

But the Lord knew how, and he knows how to help us find ways and means to do our work even better than we did it before. But we need to do what Nephi did. He followed four specific steps and got the help he needed, and if we follow those steps, we will get the help we need too.

Now to our update. You will soon get your zone interview appointment. Yes, we're going to keep doing zone interviews. Each one of you will have a private zone interview with me over video chat. I'm really looking forward to meeting with you.

We'll also be planning how to do district conferences over Zoom video. It will be great. And each of us will be learning new things that can help us fulfill our purpose, just like Nephi learned how to build a ship.

Keep being wise, elders and sisters. Keep being faithful. Keep being upbeat and hopeful. Keep being in control of your breathing, because when you control your breathing, you can control your mind. And when you control your mind, you can control your body.
I love you. I'm proud of you. Keep being awesome and make it a great day today. Thank you.
